name: High school volunteer program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers serve at M Health Fairview hospitals after an interview, online learning and orientation. Service is about 100 hours. That is roughly 3 to 4 hours a week for 6 to 9 months.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 15. Volunteers under 18 need a signed permission slip from a parent. These hospitals take teens. Ridges is in Burnsville. St. John's is in Maplewood. Southdale is in Edina. The U of M Medical Center has an East and a West Bank site. Woodwinds is in Woodbury. Lake Medical Center is in Wyoming. Northland is in Princeton.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Then you have an interview and online learning. You also need a background check, fingerprints, a TB test and proof of shots. Last is an online orientation. Call 1-855-324-7843.
notes: A flu shot each year is required. The 100 hour minimum is listed for volunteers in general.
